#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -D /data/w1/runs/run-one
#SBATCH -J nf-run-one
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH -p normal
#SBATCH -A ACCT-TEST-7
#SBATCH -c 4
#SBATCH --mem=26G
#SBATCH -t 4-00:00:00
umask 077
cd /data/w1/runs/run-one || exit 1
export SLURM_ACCOUNT=ACCT-TEST-7
export http_proxy=http://login.example:18080
export NXF_OPTS='-Dhttp.proxyHost=login.example -Dhttp.proxyPort=18080'
export NXF_SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR=/data/storage/cache
export TOWER_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(cat tower.token)"
exec nextflow run nf-core/ampliseq -r 2.18.0 -name run-one -params-file params.yaml -c nextflow.config -with-tower http://127.0.0.1:8787
forward:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -D /data/w1/runs/run-one
#SBATCH -J nf-run-one
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH -p normal
#SBATCH -A ACCT-TEST-7
#SBATCH -c 4
#SBATCH --mem=26G
#SBATCH -t 4-00:00:00
umask 077
cd /data/w1/runs/run-one || exit 1
export SLURM_ACCOUNT=ACCT-TEST-7
export http_proxy=http://login.example:18080
export NXF_OPTS='-Dhttp.proxyHost=login.example -Dhttp.proxyPort=18080 -Dhttp.nonProxyHosts='
export NXF_SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR=/data/storage/cache
ABF_FORWARD_PORT=$(cat /data/storage/_relay/forward_port 2>/dev/null)
case "$ABF_FORWARD_PORT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "abf: no usable reverse forward port in /data/storage/_relay/forward_port, so Nextflow cannot report to the platform" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
export TOWER_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(cat tower.token)"
exec nextflow run nf-core/ampliseq -r 2.18.0 -name run-one -params-file params.yaml -c nextflow.config -with-tower "http://127.0.0.1:${ABF_FORWARD_PORT}"
